meta.description: English-facing JSON extraction of summoned / invoked creatures from Wege der Zauberei, regenerated from the 2011 TruePDF rather than OCR. Entries cover elementals, spirits, demons, Thargunitoth undead, Asfaloth transformations / daimonids, and example golems.
meta.source_pages: Invocation chapter: Die Kunst der Invokation, especially Werte beschworener Wesen p.199-231 and Eigenschaften beschworener Wesen p.231-236.

field_terms.CO/CL/IN/CH/DE/AG/CN/ST: Attribute translations from MU/KL/IN/CH/FF/GE/KO/KK according to your preferred English TDE terminology.
field_terms.SP/SP*: Spell Prowess / remaining spell points where the German text used ZfW/ZfP*.
field_terms.DP: Damage Points where the German text used TP/SP depending on context.

extraction_notes: Generated from the TruePDF text layer using the same English-facing structure as the previous beasts/spells JSON files.
German proper names are preserved in german_name; display names, descriptions, attacks, services and rules labels are English wherever possible.
Entries with complex two-column layout or unclear prose keep needs_data_review=true, but the structured numeric fields are preserved in English-facing notation.

common_rules: Counts as a magical being, but not as a demonic being.
Regenerates 1 VP and 1d6 ASP per hour while within its own element.
Elemental spirits are Small; djinn are Medium; elemental masters are Large.
Elemental attacks cause magical and elemental damage of the corresponding element.
All elementals may use Feint, Called Attack, Knockdown and Counterhold; djinn and elemental masters also may use Blade Storm and Blade Wall.
All elementals have Attention and suffer no reductions from wounds or low life energy; their endurance is effectively unlimited.

All elementals can pass through their own element; are immune to poison, disease, their own element, profane and blessed attacks, and all traits except Damage; and are vulnerable to their opposite element and demonic counter-element.

spellcasting_by_rank.djinn: All spells with the trait of its element up to complexity D at SP 12.
spellcasting_by_rank.elemental_master: All spells with the trait of its element without complexity restriction at SP 20.

common_rules: Spirits are individual beings from or bound near the Fourth Sphere; many are dead souls unable to find peace.
Spirit summoning blocks include Summoning, Control and Banishment values; Banishment modifies GEISTERBANN.
Most spirits require magical means or help resolving their unfinished condition; mundane weapons are usually ineffective unless magical.

medium_humanoid_golem_base_values.special: Immunity to fire and piercing; vulnerability to cutting

golems.size_adjustment: For each size class away from Medium, VP changes by one third, damage by half (minimum 1d3), CN and ST by 2; smaller golems are quicker and more dexterous, while larger golems are slower and stronger. DE, AG and Speed change by 2/2/1 respectively per size class. Tiny/very small use distance class H, small/medium HN, large/very large NS.
golems.automatic_services: Every golem receives Movement, Following and Waiting, plus one additional service chosen by the designer. Each further possible service increases construction difficulty by 3.
golems.control_difficulty: A golem's control difficulty for the service Following equals its CL, with each point above CL 6 counting double. Aura Armor and Frenzy each increase it by 1.

summoned_creatures.name: Fire Spirit
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A fire spirit usually appears as a small, brightly burning flame. It may move up to about 100 paces from the place of summoning.

summoned_creatures.name: Djinn of Fire
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A fire djinn usually takes a humanoid shape of pure fire; its lower body often remains a flame or plume. It is passionate and volatile.

summoned_creatures.name: Elemental Master of Fire
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A master of fire contains all forms of fire: volcanic glow, blazing air, sparks and flame. It is difficult to negotiate with because it tends to see its surroundings, including the summoner, as fuel.
special_properties: Can use Blade Storm/Blade Wall against up to 4 opponents

summoned_creatures.name: Water Spirit
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A water spirit usually appears as an oversized drop of water and can form whip-like tendrils for attacks. It may move up to about 10 miles from the place of summoning.

summoned_creatures.name: Djinn of Water
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A water djinn appears as a larger water body with humanoid upper features. It is fluid, adaptable, and may be serene or threatening depending on the command.

summoned_creatures.name: Elemental Master of Water
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A master of water often appears as a towering, threatening wave in which a face can be vaguely recognized. Fresh water, salt water and brackish water may mingle in its body.
special_properties: Can use Blade Storm/Blade Wall against up to 4 opponents

summoned_creatures.name: Ore Spirit
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An ore spirit usually appears as a large stone shot through with metallic veins. It is slow and may move only about 100 paces from the place of summoning.
special_properties: Melee attacks made with weapons of ore, especially metal weapons, must make a breakage test or risk breaking.

summoned_creatures.name: Djinn of Ore
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An ore djinn commonly resembles a statue grown out of stone. Ore djinn are deliberate and stubborn, said to surpass even dwarves in obstinacy.
special_properties: Melee attacks made with weapons of ore, especially metal weapons, must make a breakage test or risk breaking.

summoned_creatures.name: Elemental Master of Ore
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A master of ore appears as a gigantic shape made from rock, ores, native metals and gemstones. It embodies the heaviness and endurance of the element.
special_properties: Can use Blade Storm/Blade Wall against up to 4 opponents
Melee attacks made with weapons of ore, especially metal weapons, must make a breakage test or risk breaking.

summoned_creatures.name: Air Spirit
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An air spirit usually appears as a small whirlwind. It is extremely agile and may move up to 100 miles from the place of summoning.

summoned_creatures.name: Djinn of Air
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An air djinn, or wind-bride, usually consists of a small whirlwind from which a humanoid upper body of pure air and drifting clouds rises. It is impulsive and restless.

summoned_creatures.name: Elemental Master of Air
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A master of air most often manifests as a house-sized whirlwind mixing icy high air and summer-warm ground air. It has a blustering temperament and speaks in a shrill, very fast language.
special_properties: Can use Blade Storm/Blade Wall against up to 4 opponents

summoned_creatures.name: Humus Spirit
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A humus spirit often manifests as a small tree or large shrub. It can move up to about 1 mile from the place of summoning and attacks with thorned, rapidly growing tendrils.

summoned_creatures.name: Djinn of Humus
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A humus djinn often resembles a forest spirit or living plant-being, usually with a more pleasant appearance. It is empathetic and well-disposed toward living things.

summoned_creatures.name: Elemental Master of Humus
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A master of humus resembles a large tree full of insects, small animals, moss and strange flowers. It sees all things in the context of the renewing cycle of life.
special_properties: Can use Blade Storm/Blade Wall against up to 4 opponents

summoned_creatures.name: Ice Spirit
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A typical ice spirit appears as an oversized snow crystal and may move up to about 1 mile from the summoning place. It attacks with a formed, extremely sharp ice sword.

summoned_creatures.name: Djinn of Ice
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An ice djinn often looks like a statue carved from ice or even a snowman. It is governed by ice-cold logic and is hostile to living things, tolerating even its summoner only if convinced.
special_properties: Can be boand outside the Eternal Ice for at most one year.

summoned_creatures.name: Elemental Master of Ice
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A master of ice manifests like a small iceberg with falling snow and a cold aura. It is brilliant, hostile to life, and dangerous even to call. Living beings within 3 paces suffer 3 DP per game turn from the cold it radiates.
special_properties: Can use Blade Storm/Blade Wall against up to 4 opponents
Ice Breath: living beings within 3 paces suffer 3 DP per game turn
Can be boand outside the Eternal Ice for at most one year.

summoned_creatures.name: Bound Soul
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A soul bound to a fixed place, usually through curse, guilt or unfinished business. It usually cannot move more than 7 paces from its place of manifestation or death.

summoned_creatures.name: Night Alp
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A nightmare spirit appearing as a black shadow that crouches on a sleeper's chest and forces dreams of suffocation or drowning. It may move up to about 1 mile from its summoning place or place of death.

summoned_creatures.name: Spook
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A poltergeist-like haunting that cannot end its own invisibility and can damage only unliving matter. Its destructive effects can still harm bystanders indirectly.

summoned_creatures.name: Will-o'-Wisp
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A ghostly light of swamp and marsh. It imitates moaning or cries and, by its nature, repeatedly draws victims into deadly bogs, though it cannot simply be commanded to lure a specific victim.
special_properties: Frightening Presence I through soands and light

summoned_creatures.name: Apparition
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An apparition is the half-material manifestation of a deceased animal or similar being. Its values match the living animal of the same kind, but with RM 12 and AR equal to half RM.

stats.rules: Use the values of the living animal of the same species; RM 12; AR equals half RM.

special_properties: Damage against animated/unanimated matter depending on creature
Special combat rules depend on the animal

summoned_creatures.name: Achorhobai
summoned_creatures.german_name: -Einführungvortrag der vormaligen Magistra gehörnter Diener Agrimoths Achorhobai
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Achorhobai, the White Worm and Great Alchemist, is a four-horned servant of Agrimoth. It resembles a huge white worm with wart-covered, acid-sweating skin, split tentacles and horns around a circular maw. It bores through rock to reach gems and metals, dissolving other material with vitriolic digestive fluids.
special_properties: Attack with cursed element (acid, see above), Follow-up damage (acid, see above), Regeneration I, Vulnerability (Ingerimm, ore)

summoned_creatures.name: Agribaal
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Agribaal, the Curse of Iron, is a one-horned servant of Agrimoth or Iribaar. It is a non-corporeal demon usually called down to inhabit artifacts, especially weapons, when a demonic presence is desired.

summoned_creatures.name: Amrifas
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Amrifas the Earth-Shaker is a nine-horned servant of Agrimoth. It is credited with the power to unleash earthquakes and volcanic eruptions; the force sacrificed by the summoner influences the strength of the disaster. No fixed worldly body is known.

summoned_creatures.name: Amrychoth
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Amrychoth, the Dark Ray and Shadow in the Cyclone, is a five-horned servant of Charyptoroth. It manifests like an enormous triangular ray moving through water, surrounded by demonic currents, and can alter sea currents or unleash underwater storms and maelstroms.
special_properties: Attack with cursed water (AT 6, 3d6 DP), Regeneration I, waterwe sen

summoned_creatures.name: Living Corpse
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A living corpse is an animated human or humanoid dead body. It fights with bare hands or simple weapons and is one of the basic forms of necromantic undead.

summoned_creatures.name: Mummy
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A mummy is a corpse preserved by embalming or drying. Its main traits are enormous physical strength and vulnerability to fire. Mummification is common in Tulamid lands and occasionally known farther north through Norbard influence.

summoned_creatures.name: Skeleton
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A skeleton is what remains when a corpse has lain long enough in the grave that only bones and metal grave goods remain. It may still use weapons and armor buried with it.

summoned_creatures.name: Animal Carcass and Skeleton
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Animal carcasses and animal skeletons are necromantically animated dead beasts. Wolves, bulls, warhorses, dogs and great cats are especially common choices. Their values are based on the living animal and then modified by decay or skeletal condition.

summoned_creatures.name: Zombie
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Zombies are heavily decayed undead. They are slow, too clumsy for armor, fight with their hands or remaining limbs, suffer no wounds, and are notorious carriers of disease.

summoned_creatures.name: Dog-Flower
summoned_creatures.german_name: Hundeblume Gelegentlich wird er von der rasenden Wut
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Dog-Flower is a chimera entry. The OCR for this block is badly contaminated, so only the translated combat values and properties should be treated as tentative.

summoned_creatures.name: Manlikor
summoned_creatures.german_name: Claws: distance classN AT 11 DP 1d6+5 speedO EP 20 RM 15 G1d2 Manlikor
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: Manlikor is a chimera entry. The OCR mixed this block with neighboring entries, so its translated name and combat data are tentative and should be checked against the page image.

summoned_creatures.name: Wolf-Lizard
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: The wolf-lizard is a chimera, probably an early experiment from the Borbaradian period. It is reptilian like other lizards and is cold-sensitive.

summoned_creatures.name: Ram-Hyena
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: The ram-hyena was created by the great chimera-master Zurbaran as a guard creature. After Zurbaran's death, the creatures reproduced and have long been found in the High North; some snow goblin clans use them as mounts and battle companions.

summoned_creatures.name: Snake-Man
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: The snake-man is a repulsive chimera made from a constrictor snake and a human. Its upper body, arms and head are human, while the long lower body is serpentine. It can use ordinary weapons and fitted armor, but is neither quick-witted nor fast to react.

summoned_creatures.name: Myrkkyaa-Kaika
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: The Myrkkyaa-Kaika is an unnatural cross between a Usuzoreel and a snow lynx, known in the High North. It combines the lynx's intelligence with demonic malice, making it a merciless, cold-hearted hunter.

summoned_creatures.name: Famulus
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: The Famulus, called the Casteless Servant, is likely a cross between Dharai and human. It is created for brutal physical labor: mining, quarrying, hauling immense loads, or destroying whatever task is put before it.

summoned_creatures.name: White Hunter
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: The White Hunter is a daimonid with two wolf heads, a spiked tail and the shoulder height of about one pace. It is a cross between a silver wolf and Tuur-Amash and is especially common in Tobrien.

summoned_creatures.name: Homunculus
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A homunculus is a grey-clay golem about nine spans tall with roughly human features. Its stiff face may show faint expression, but overall it is clumsy and could pass for a crude statue when motionless.
special_properties: Immunity to piercing attacks and fire
Morate sensitivity to objects blessed by Tsa

summoned_creatures.name: Walking Chest (Wood)
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A walking chest is a creaking clothes chest that moves on four short legs like a small Tuzak hound. It can carry its creator's treasures and attacks enemies by snapping its lid open and shut.
special_properties: Morate sensitivity to objects blessed by Tsa

summoned_creatures.name: Mephir
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A Mephir is a very small gargoyle-like golem used by its creator for spying. It is usually made of marble, about two spans tall, and resembles a little human whose arms have been replaced by wings.
special_properties: Immunity to fire, piercing attacks and the Form trait
Morate sensitivity to objects blessed by Ingerimm

summoned_creatures.name: Ogre Statue
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: An ogre statue is a bronze statue of a two-and-a-half-pace-tall ogre. It is not detailed, but imposing; legends say Leonardo the Mechanicus uses such beings to guard his greatest masterpieces.
special_properties: Immunity to fire, piercing attacks and the Form trait
Morate sensitivity to objects blessed by Ingerimm

summoned_creatures.name: Quicksand Golemid
summoned_creatures.source: Wege der Zauberei (2011 TruePDF), invocation chapter, values of summoned beings
summoned_creatures.description: A quicksand golemid is an extremely rare sand construct whose grains are individually controlled. It can slide under doors and through bars, reform into a humanoid shape, move almost silently, and is effectively unharmed by normal weapons passing through it.
